integrity: The proof is analytic and algebraic, with a standard-library computational corroboration. Priority comparisons are bounded and not a guarantee of historic uniqueness. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the five consecutive characters on the eight-cycle and fourth moment are treated. Historic cyclic tabulations could be equivalent. Full primary texts of two relevant old articles were not accessible. Infinite or larger-group conclusions are not asserted.
title: A sharp Nyquist-resonant fourth moment for five Fourier characters on the eight-cycle
